audit.why: Glacial Prison is 120s at rank 1 with 1300 range and it is a stun — that is the real level-6 shift, and it is the same fact the mirror states from Sejuani's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate errors. (a) 'Dodge her Arctic Assault (W dash)' — Arctic Assault is her Q, and it is a knock-up charge, not a dash-to-target. (b) 'her Frost Armor passive only matters once she takes damage and stacks' — backwards. (c) 'her percent-HP W' — Winter's Wrath carries no percent-health damage in Riot's text.
audit.why: Riot: Fury of the North gives Frost Armor AFTER being out of combat, and it persists only a short time after she takes damage — so she starts with it and you strip it by keeping her in combat. Winter's Wrath 'swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks' — no percent health. Arctic Assault is Q, 18s at rank 1, 650 range, and knocks enemies into the air.
audit.corrected: Arctic Assault named as Q with its cooldown and its knock-up; Frost Armor described the right way round (keep her in combat and it never returns); the percent-HP claim removed and replaced with Frost stacking.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the matchup said that Sejuani's hard CC ends Aegis Assault.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is a channel. Arctic Assault knocks up and Glacial Prison stuns; both are hard CC, and the mirror already states this interaction from Sejuani's side ('Glacial Prison gives you a long-range stun that cancels Aegis Assault outright').
audit.corrected: Written into mid, whys[4] and breakdown.cooldowns: never set the shield while Arctic Assault or Glacial Prison is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eight strings tell the player to 'track Permafrost', 'engage only on Permafrost's cooldown', 'commit on Permafrost's cooldown'.
audit.why: Permafrost is a flat 1.5-second cooldown. There is no window to wait for. The resource that actually gates her stun is Frost stacks, applied by Winter's Wrath (9s at rank 1).
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, dosFull[0], report[5] and loading rewritten to deny Frost stacks rather than wait on a 1.5s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright' in phases[0].why and breakdown.early.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will — every few spells or attacks his next spell is empowered. He has no passive shield. The shield is Aegis Assault (E), 22s at rank 1, and it is invulnerable from the front only.
audit.corrected: Both strings rewritten around Mortal Will and Comet Spear.

edits.before: Sejuani is one of the easiest early lanes to bully — she has no sustain and her Frost Armor passive only matters once she takes damage and stacks. Use empowered Q poke and your point-and-click W stun to win short trades at every level; at 2 you can W-in, Q, and walk away up health. Dodge her Arctic Assault (W dash) range so she cannot stick to you, and never let her freely stack Permafrost — once she has 3 marks her E stuns you. Your E block eats her R if she tries to engage.
edits.after: Sejuani is one of the easiest early lanes to bully — Fury of the North gives her Frost Armor after she drops out of combat, so keep her in combat with Comet Spear and it never comes back. Use empowered Q poke and your point-and-click Shield Vault to win short trades at every level; at 2 you can W in, Q, and walk away up health. Respect Arctic Assault (Q, 18s at rank 1, 650 range) — it is a knock-up charge, and hard CC cancels Aegis Assault mid-channel. Deny Frost stacks and Permafrost has nothing to detonate.

edits.before: You still control levels 4-5 with empowered-Q poke and your E shrugging off her engage, but raw kills dry up — she just farms and builds tank stats. At 6 your Grand Starfall is your real win condition: this is a farm-stall lane against a tank, so leap to a side lane and cash your early tempo into kills she cannot contest. Do not sit here trying to solo-kill a Sejuani who already has armor and HP — your burst plateaus while she only gets tankier.
edits.after: You still control levels 4-5 with empowered-Q poke, but raw kills dry up — she farms and builds tank stats. Do not wait out Permafrost: it is a 1.5-second cooldown, so what you deny is the Frost stacks Winter's Wrath applies. At 6 Glacial Prison reaches 1300 and its stun cancels Aegis Assault mid-channel, so never set the shield while her R is up. Grand Starfall is your real win condition — leap to a side lane and cash your early tempo into kills she cannot contest.

Your only path is the lead you built levels 1-6 — if you snowballed via Starfall roams you win the game; if the lane went even, respect her engage, group, and let your team peel for you because you do not 1v1 her at 2+ items.

notes: SYSTEMIC AND CHAMPION-WIDE, worth acting on beyond this matchup: the string 'Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright' appears 140 times in champ-data/pantheon.full.js (phases[0].why and breakdown.early on essentially every matchup). Pantheon has no passive shield — Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few spells or attacks. The shield is Aegis Assault (E), 22/21/20/19/18s, invulnerable from the FRONT only, and a channel. This matches what the Teemo mirror agent diagnosed: the text was written against champ-data/_kits/jadepantheon.json's Aegis Protection passive. A single scripted pass over those 140 strings would be worth more than any individual audit. Second systemic issue in this matchup: eight strings tell the player to trade 'around Permafrost's cooldown'. Permafrost is a flat 1.5 seconds — the advice is unusable as written, and the real gate is Frost stacks from Winter's Wrath. Third: 'Arctic Assault (W dash)' is wrong twice over — it is her Q and it is a knock-up charge.
